Real Events v0.1.0
==================

First public release candidate.

Added
-----

- Dynamic production event system.
- Production crisis event type.
- Production boom event type.
- 1 to 5 simultaneous event cities.
- Random event duration from 1 to 12 30-day months.
- Random event evaluation interval from 30 to 90 game days.
- Absolute-day tracking based on Gametime / 256.
- Per-campaign sidecar persistence.
- Town production hook.
- Private/Trader production hook.
- Tavern Informer rumour integration.
- Runtime hook byte validation.

Fixed
-----

- Boom events originally failed to apply because the production helper returned
  early for every percentage >= 100. The condition now only bypasses scaling at
  exactly 100%.
- Debug window formatting crash fixed during development.

Changed
-------

- Public project name is Real Events.
- Persistence filenames use RealEvents_<campaign-hash>.dat.
- Development hotkeys and diagnostic tools are excluded from the public build.

Known limitations
-----------------

- External INI configuration is not implemented yet.
- Informer event prose is English only.
- Compatibility is validated only against the tested GOG executable/modloader
  build.
